headline: Volkswagen Lamando Has Release Date in Mexico; Brand Emphasizes Quality Despite Chinese Origin
summary: Volkswagen confirmed the presentation date for the Lamando in Mexico and said it adapted the vehicle for the local market. The brand emphasised quality despite the car's Chinese origin.
why: Volkswagen is a German carmaker with a large Mexican production and sales base, and new models shape its competitiveness in the market.
original_headline: El Volkswagen Lamando ya tiene fecha de estreno en México y la marca enfatiza que tendrá calidad a pesar de su origen chino
